profile.headline: MS CS | Software Engineer | Front End Developer | Full Stack Developer
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer at Tata Consultancy Services, I develop batch infrastructure and data-intensive applications using Spring, Oracle, JMS, and Java web services. I also use Spring Boot Acutuator to monitor and manage the application in production environment.

I graduated with a Master's degree in Computer Science from The University of Texas at Arlington in Dec 2021, where I gained hands-on experience in web development, WordPress, Sitecore, and Cascade. I also completed an internship at TWG Companies, where I re-architected efficient and reusable code, and created the backend database architecture for a social media platform using AWS and serverless technologies.

I am proficient in Java, Python, and SQL, and have a strong knowledge of micro-service architectures, REST API, and cloud computing. I am passionate about designing, developing, and implementing innovative software solutions that meet user needs and project objectives. I enjoy working with diverse and collaborative teams, and I am always eager to learn new skills and technologies.

projects.title: Cloud Based Application (AWS, Azure, Google, IBM)
projects.description:
•  To show and analyze data for improved predictions, we used the K means method in Python on several cloud providers.
•  Using Python and Flask, I designed and created a user interface to present data in bar and histogram form.
•  To acquire data from several cloud services and integrate data using Pandas data frames, I wrote business logic in Python.
•  For a faster run time, I used Redis cache, Apache JMeter, and auto scaling.

projects.title: Loan Prediction Analysis
projects.description:
• Tested algorithms like Neural Network, Naïve Bayes, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, KNN, SVM Algorithms in Python to improve accuracy.
•  The study focused on finding the best classifier for predicting the loan eligibility process based on customer details provided.
•  Used Tensor flow for deep neural networks.
